disclaimer: synthetic images, not real cameras: these are synthetic-test findings about the sampled conditions only; they do not measure or guarantee real-camera performance, and a zero-event bound applies only to the sampled synthetic condition distribution (independent seeded trials).
method: Every recorded false-accept seed and the first 6 recorded failing seeds of every cell were re-run and the image given to the reader was inspected. A blob is a detected marker with bits 0x1FFFFFF (the signature of the documented 0x5AC54 finding: an isolated black blob inside a marker data area accepted as a marker). A failure counts as consequentially spurious only when such a blob was a member of the decoded group. Trials with a blob detected (anywhere in the image): 0; of these, blob not a group member: 0.
limits: Only the first 6 recorded failing seeds per cell were re-run (a cell stores at most 20); cells with more failures than that are covered by a sample of their failures, not all of them. Correct trials were not inspected.

The decoder result lists no markers for NOT_DETECTED, INVALID_MARKER and INCOMPLETE_GROUP; for these the image was checked with detectMarkers directly, so a blob can be seen but its effect on the result is not attributable from the result alone.
A spurious marker other than the 0x1FFFFFF signature (SPURIOUS_CANDIDATE with other bits) is counted in trialsWithSpuriousCandidates but not classified.
